hints.title: Formula Transformation
hints.text: Since points are sorted by x and i < j, xj - xi > 0. The expression yi + yj + |xi - xj| transforms to (yi - xi) + (yj + xj).

hints.title: Sliding Window Constraint
hints.text: For each point j, we seek the maximum value of (yi - xi) among all previous points i satisfying xj - xi <= k.

hints.title: Monotonic Queue Maintenance
hints.text: Maintain a double-ended queue storing pairs (yi - xi, xi) in descending order of value, popping expired elements where xj - xi > k.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all pairs (i, j) naively takes O(N^2) time which times out for N = 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Monotonic deque processes each point in amortized O(1) time and O(N) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate algebraically splits the equation into independent i and j terms to identify sliding window maximum.
complexity.notes: Every point is pushed and popped at most once.
